minor: 'In 1997, a small California start-up called Netflix set out to rent films by mail': the company was founded in 1997, but the mail rental service launched in 1998. Say 'founded in 1997' or 'in 1998 began renting'.
'Over the next two years, Antioco made two costly bets' follows a 2004 start, yet the online launch is also dated 2004 and the late-fee end is January 2005. Say 'In 2004 and 2005'.

'Antioco's account points to a board that would not keep paying for the fight' goes slightly beyond the source, in which the board questioned the online spending and disputed his pay. 'A board that questioned the spending' is closer.
'Keyes points to forces beyond Netflix' extends the sourced line 'Netflix did not kill Blockbuster'. It is a fair paraphrase but not a direct quote.
'Outside supermarkets, Redbox kiosks' and 'walls of tapes, open late' are scene colour with no listed source. They change nothing.
'Less than a year later, that deal was over': July 2000 to March 2001 is about eight months, so it is accurate.
The cold open says Keyes is Blockbuster's 'later chief executive', which fits, since he took over in 2007. The listed Fortune interview supports it.
